repolish.setting.name: Clip name
repolish.setting.name.tooltip: File name used under the repolish folder in your game directory.
repolish.setting.fov.tooltip: Used while previewing or exporting when custom FOV is on.
repolish.setting.smoothing.tooltip: Turns stepped TAS turns into smooth mouse sweeps. Zero keeps the raw look.
repolish.setting.responsiveness.tooltip: Keeps fast flicks crisp and centered on the action so they never trail like spectator mode.
repolish.recordings.empty: No takes or exported videos yet. Record a take with F8 to open it in the first-person editor.
repolish.hint: Record a take with F8, then stop to open the live first-person editor. Tweak smoothing, responsiveness, FOV, and shaders while watching your take live, then click Export video.
repolish.chat.marker_idle: Start a recording or open a take before placing markers.
